label: sprint backlog
definition: What one sprint took from the backlog and how it will be done: the issues on the sprint's GitHub milestone, with the sub-issues of each effort as its tasks. The sprint goal says why it holds these; the builders may add or split tasks during the sprint.
is_not: The backlog: the backlog is all the work not yet taken; the sprint backlog is this week's share.
A wave: a wave is one parallel batch of the sprint backlog; a sprint usually runs several.
A checklist in an issue body: the sprint backlog is issues on a milestone, each with its own state.
